_comment: peft_compose bake-off Phase A on Llama-2-7B (the 7B port of peft_bakeoff_1b.json, 2026-07-23). Hyperparameters are held IDENTICAL to the 1B config so the 7B run is a controlled cross-model replication of the composition plateau (1B Phase A: composed mu 0.415-0.434 vs base 0.3796 / ft_all 0.5302). Only model_name, dir_template and ks_reference change. NB Llama-2-7B is MHA (q/k/v/o all 4096->4096), so the VeRA uniform-shape restriction inherited from the 1B GQA config is moot here but kept for comparability.

prefix._comment: compose = KV concat (prefix_concat.py). Prompt-learning trains slowly and stores facts in soft tokens only -> method-standard high lr + longer schedule (recorded, not recipe-matched).

vera._comment: compose = elementwise mean of vera_lambda_* in the SHARED frozen basis. projection_prng_key fixed so every shard sees the same basis; save_projection so composed dirs are self-contained. target_modules kept as the 1B run's [q_proj,o_proj] for cross-model comparability (7B MHA would permit k/v too).

ia3._comment: compose = mean of gate vectors (arith primary / geo secondary in compose_peft.py). Paper-standard placement: k/v attention gates + ff gate; feedforward_modules must be a subset of target_modules.

dora._comment: additive CONTROL arm: LoRA+DoRA at the frozen-recipe shape, non-rslora so a 1/N merge is a true mean. Composed via the existing LoRA additive path ONLY if peft accepts DoRA in add_weighted_adapter (CPU probe gates this).
